content:
maria_sales: @sean_cust heads-up — the prospect asked for our latest SOC 2 Type II and wants us to sign their NDA before the POC. can we share the report and sign?
sean_cust: they also want a bridge letter covering a 30-day gap between their contract start and our auditor attestation. POC kickoff is next week, they want everything signed quick.
ash_infra: we have the SOC2 report at org level. we usually redact vendor subcontractor lists. for Dedicated deployments we may need to confirm network scope but that doesn't block a report share.
jordan_security: we can provide a redacted SOC2 Type II and a controls mapping doc. bridge letters are typically legal attestations — we can do one that confirms our controls were in place since X date. need the exact date range the customer expects.
liz_legal: we can sign an NDA if it's mutual and standard. please push their NDA and the bridge-letter draft to legal for redline. note: we do not accept open-ended indemnities; we'll counter any clause that expands liability materially.
sean_cust: forwarding now — customer included their NDA and a one-page bridge draft. they asked to remove the "no liability" sentence in our counter, and need signature within 48h to keep POC timeline.
maria_sales: POC is time-sensitive. if legal needs >48h, can we offer our standard bridge attestation as an interim? also can we publish the SOC2 to the customer portal rather than email?
liz_legal: i have a standard one-page bridge attestation i can sign quickly. i'll redline their bridge draft and propose our attestation as a short-term solution. i'll also check the NDA for any unusual data residency or security carve-outs.
jordan_security: customer asked for IR evidence too — we can send an excerpt of our incident response runbook and a mapping of SOC2 control IDs to our IR process.
compliance-bot: SOC2 report (redacted) uploaded: https://s3.redwood.example/soc2/2025-redwood-soc2-type2-redacted.pdf :lock:
maria_sales: great — liz, please ping when the redline/attestation is ready. sean, confirm you forwarded the docs. i'll tell the customer we can provide a redacted SOC2 and a signed bridge attestation within 24h pending legal review.
sean_cust: docs forwarded to liz@redwood. customer says if we can't turn around in 24-48h they will push the POC start. i'll escalate on my side.
liz_legal: acknowledged. i'll prioritize review and aim to issue the signed attestation within 24h. if any clause in their NDA is unacceptable i'll propose targeted edits and call out the exposure.
ash_infra: FYI if they sign and want Dedicated, schedule a quick scoping call on network isolation and KMS integration. that'll avoid later blockers.
maria_sales: thanks all — i'll update the prospect and flag the deadline. :thumbsup:
